subject: Science
learning_goal: Master the chapter content using source-grounded explanations, practice and revision.

sections.heading: Learning Point 1
sections.content: 4 Chapter Reshma lives in a coastal town of Kerala and is very fond of writing short stories.
sections.source_evidence: 4 Chapter Reshma lives in a coastal town of Kerala and is very fond of writing short stories.

sections.heading: Learning Point 2
sections.content: Her grandmother loves listening to her stories, so Reshma was writing a new story to share with her grandmother on her 60th birthday.
sections.source_evidence: Her grandmother loves listening to her stories, so Reshma was writing a new story to share with her grandmother on her 60th birthday.

sections.heading: Learning Point 3
sections.content: Exploring Magnets The story was based on a ship carrying spices from Kerala for trade in the olden days.
sections.source_evidence: Exploring Magnets The story was based on a ship carrying spices from Kerala for trade in the olden days.

sections.heading: Learning Point 4
sections.content: Reshma was aware that in those days, the sailors used stars to find directions at night.
sections.source_evidence: Reshma was aware that in those days, the sailors used stars to find directions at night.

sections.heading: Learning Point 5
sections.content: But in her story, a situation arose wherein the sailors got caught in a storm with an overcast sky and stars were not visible.
sections.source_evidence: But in her story, a situation arose wherein the sailors got caught in a storm with an overcast sky and stars were not visible.

sections.heading: Learning Point 6
sections.content: Reshma could not take her story forward as she could not think of a way for sailors to find directions.
sections.source_evidence: Reshma could not take her story forward as she could not think of a way for sailors to find directions.

sections.heading: Learning Point 7
sections.content: She searched for information on the internet and her school library.
sections.source_evidence: She searched for information on the internet and her school library.

sections.heading: Learning Point 8
sections.content: She learnt that the travellers used a device, known as a magnetic compass, for finding directions.
sections.source_evidence: She learnt that the travellers used a device, known as a magnetic compass, for finding directions.

sections.heading: Learning Point 9
sections.content: Reshma had seen pencil boxes and purses which had magnets to keep them closed.
sections.source_evidence: Reshma had seen pencil boxes and purses which had magnets to keep them closed.

sections.heading: Learning Point 10
sections.content: A writing board in her school also had a duster with a magnet.
sections.source_evidence: A writing board in her school also had a duster with a magnet.

sections.heading: Learning Point 11
sections.content: But she had never looked at those carefully.
sections.source_evidence: But she had never looked at those carefully.

sections.heading: Learning Point 12
sections.content: She now became curious to learn more about magnets and magnetic compasses.
sections.source_evidence: She now became curious to learn more about magnets and magnetic compasses.

sections.heading: Learning Point 13
sections.content: The magnets used by sailors in the olden days were based on naturally occurring magnets, known as lodestones which were discovered in ancient times.
sections.source_evidence: The magnets used by sailors in the olden days were based on naturally occurring magnets, known as lodestones which were discovered in ancient times.

sections.heading: Learning Point 14
sections.content: Later on, people found out that magnets could also be made from pieces of iron.
sections.source_evidence: Later on, people found out that magnets could also be made from pieces of iron.

sections.heading: Learning Point 15
sections.content: Nowadays, we have magnets made of different materials.
sections.source_evidence: Nowadays, we have magnets made of different materials.
